bio: Bang in the heart of a peaceful street of Montrouge, get ready to embark on a culinary voyage from Asia to South America. Nikkei cuisine, a genuine fusion of Japanese and Peruvian culinary traditions, emerged in the late 19C when Japanese migrants discovered the criolla flavours of Peru. In this welcoming eatery, globetrotting chef, Maïna-Sophie Conil, explores this gourmet marriage in flavoursome, fusion-inspired recipes: fragrant ceviche laced in ginger and lime; crunchy tempura fish or carpaccio of Simmenthal beef enhanced by a truffle jus. The garden terrace is a hit in fine weather....
